newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent late-November unleaded plunges.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent late-November unleaded plunges.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline basis plunged Monday in Group Three as sellers attempted to shed barrels in late-month trade, traders said.
The weakness rippled through the neighboring Chicago cash market, where unleaded moved lower for late-November barrels in trade expected to wrap up on Tuesday.
"Nobody wants anything," one broker said as sellers emerging in the market were greeted by a dearth of buyers.
The sell-off spiced up what otherwise had been seen as a lackluster few days of trading ahead of the long Thanksgiving Day holiday weekend.
Group Three unleaded gasoline differentials eased to 1.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded asked, with bids talked about 0.50 cent a gallon weaker.

Chicago unleaded differentials lost more than a cent, with discussion at 2.25/2.50 cents a gallon over the print for late-November deliveries. First-cycle December barrels eased to 3.25/3.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX January unleaded futures.
Group Three high sulphur diesel was talked 3.25 cents a gallon under the print, easing on talk of a sizable first-cycle delivery into the regional pipeline system.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 2.0 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and even with the print in Chicago late in the day, traders said.
